[[File:PoggleTheLesser-TCWCE.png|thumb|200px|Archduke Poggle the Lesser during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
'''Archduke''' was a title of nobility.<ref name="PoG3">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref> It was the title of the ruler of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], or [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]], the planet's ruling hive. A symbol of their position was the Archduke's [[Staff of Command/Legends|Staff of Command]].<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Notable Archdukes included [[Hadiss the Vaulted/Legends|Hadiss the Vaulted]] and [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]].

[[Monio]] of the [[Dentamma Nebula/Legends|Dentamma Nebula]] was an Archduke.<ref name="PoG3" />
